4.1: Now Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, saying, “I have acquired a man from the LORD.”
4.2: Then she bore again, his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a worker of the ground.
4.3: And in the course of time it came to pass that Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.
4.4: Abel also brought from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat portions. The LORD respected Abel and his offering.
4.5: But Cain and his offering He did not respect. And Cain became deeply angered, and his countenance fell.
4.6: So the LORD said to Cain, “Why has anger overtaken you? And why has your countenance fallen?”
4.7: If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin is crouching at the door; its desire is for you, but you must rule over it.
4.8: Now Cain spoke to Abel his brother; and it came to pass, as they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
4.9: Then the LORD said to Cain, “Where is your brother Abel?” Cain said, “I do not know—am I my brother’s keeper?”
